title: Panel de Estado de Personaje RPG Estilo Japonés con Personaje Cartoon 3D e Interfaz Transparente
prompt: The character status panel from a Japanese-style RPG game, and the game uses a 3D cartoon style. The left side of the screen is the character information box, and the right side is the pixel character standing illustration. The left side uses many semi-transparent UI panels: basic information, name, level, HP, MP. Equipment, weapon, armor, accessory. Limit skill: making videos and making games.
